measurement_rule.warm: The scored boundary begins after a fresh verified generation is fully prepared and trust state is committed.
measurement_rule.cold: The scored boundary begins before fresh verified assembly; preparation, trust-state commit, and click share one non-resettable three-second parent deadline.

traffic_control_rule.delay: Apply half the declared RTT to client and server egress.
traffic_control_rule.loss: Apply q=1-sqrt(1-p) independently to client and server egress, where p is the declared round-trip loss fraction.
traffic_control_rule.capacity: Apply the declared capacity independently to client and server egress.

profiles.purpose: Constrained mobile or congested access network.
